title: The Patient Soul of the Sacred House
intro: In the pages of the Quran, a figure emerges from the lineage of a great prophet, granted as a gift in old age. This soul is celebrated for unwavering truthfulness and a profound role in establishing a sanctuary that would become a beacon of faith. As you read the clues, listen carefully to the voice from the past, for it speaks in the first person.
clues: I am mentioned in the Quran alongside another prophet as a gift granted to an elderly messenger.
I was one of two offspring bestowed upon that prophet in his later years.
I am praised in the Quran for being true to my word.
I carried the honor of prophethood and was sent as a messenger.
I joined my father in raising the foundations of the Sacred House.
I am remembered as one of the patient ones, and the sacred house we built became a place of return and security for people.

arabic: ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ ٱلَّذِى وَهَبَ لِى عَلَى ٱلْكِبَرِ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبِّى لَسَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verse: Praise to Allāh, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication. (14:39)
